Real use cases

Summarizing long documents Feed in a long report or contract and get a structured summary.
Long-form writing and editing Draft, restructure, and edit long content in a consistent voice.
Pair-programming and debugging Scaffold a feature, then debug it in the same conversation.

Bottom line

Claude is the assistant to reach for when the task is writing- or reasoning-heavy: long documents, contracts, research summaries, careful edits. It's less flashy than some competitors — no built-in image generation, a smaller plugin ecosystem — but it's consistently the most careful reader and writer of the group we've tested.

Frequently asked questions

Is Claude free to use?

Yes, there's a free plan with a limited number of daily messages.

What's the difference between Claude and ChatGPT?

Claude tends to edge ahead on long-document handling and careful writing; ChatGPT has a wider plugin ecosystem.

Can Claude read PDFs and images?

Yes, you can upload PDFs, images, and other documents directly into a conversation.

Does Claude have a mobile app?

Yes, it's available on iOS and Android, plus web and desktop.

Can I use Claude for coding?

Yes — it writes, explains, and debugs code across most mainstream languages.

Is there a business or team plan?

Yes, with central billing, admin controls, and pooled usage limits.

When was Claude last tested by Luvent?

We last tested it on 2026-08-01.
